book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Iesu la magosong kibap ma lop o usingnualap

Tie, la ula babau o la o Pasova la tale ka betieng. Ga ait Iesu, tara la betong ara meba oolaing urio kimanam ga ina ala ai Mamo na panbinim. Mitara mabouvara teip ga magaulap am la maionama na uro kimanam. Ga mabouvara poieng la uvara.
Nabit, Iesu ga lop am o usingnualap la man maionama ga parakmeng. Pa Satan la uabura agat ang na dalap a Iudas poi ang Simon Iskariot, meba abung Iesu na kilalap ma karorap am.
Iesu la oit ara gare ro, Mamo la ualam ara mirie pagap na kilan a. Ait kan Morowa la asagaong ga muo, ga eba gat ina ala ai Morowa.
Are ratmat ga teuara ga aulai luaga o parak, ga unio sasa ang ula laklago, ga uaro non taul ga ovisong ira karima a.
Tie, ourukong burunam na non dis ga okosarong ubi ula papalu la ume okosar migana o ubi. Eva, puaro la magosong kibap ma lop o usingnualap ga mabaula a taul o tebanulap urie la ovisong ira karima a.
Tie, okosarong gare tiro puoieng la muo ai Simon Petro. Ga ugama Petro, “Ila Kakani, atabo nuga akosarnang tavuk ang migana o ubi agarit ga legosnang kibapien tuo gat, a?”
Upulo Iesu ties ang ga ugama, “Paga la akosartung ira nuo titot, irie la tale kan anit. Pa tubiat ga eba anera.”
Petro la ugama, “Ila Kakani, buat magosnung kibap tuo. Tala kan!” Iesu la upulo ties ang, “Petro, leba tale nogostang, tie tala kan nunuo migana ruang o usingnualap.”
Simon Petro la upto uriro ties ang Iesu ga turupuaba kirat ga ugama, “Ila Kakani, leba are ba rie, barabat agosnung it kiban tuo. Karuk. Pa legosnang gat kilalapien tuo ga bugam tuo!”
Iesu la ugama, “Petro, migana la uviet ara tala gat ina uviet. Agosang it kiban a ga eba babai ba gane. Eva, mibabaim ara. Pa tale tiestung me mimir ganam.”
Iesu la ait ara iriro migana Iudas la namo abung na kilalap ma karorap. Are ratmat ga ugama, “Tale kan mimi ganam la mibabaum.”
Urie, magosong ara Iesu kibap ma lop o usingnualap, ga ina uabua sasa ang ila laklage ga unama. Ga mamarikong gare ro, “Atabo amit muana a iriro paga la akosartung ira mi?
Mime tomiva migana o usingnualap o Ila Kakani. Ga mumuru la tomiva gare rie.
Turuo Ila Kakani ga migana o usingnualap ming, la magostung kibap mi. Are ratmat ga mimi gat le magosming kibap ma teip ga magaulap a non gar buang.
Misingtuala ra a iriro tavuk, ga mimi gat le akosarming iriet tavuk gare titot la akosartung ira mi.
Mirulo migat: Migana o ubi la tale kan kakani me ila kakani ang. Ga migana o usaga la tale kan kakani me migana la asagaong ga ula.
Titot la amit ara muana o uriro agat ga tavuk la akosartung, pa leba amiuluan maset, tie Morowa leba milaminaisang.

Tale kan tiestung me mimir ganam. Mirit mimi teip la miterung mimi tuam, ga omit ties la iot na babam ang Morowa, la eba betieng migat. Uriro ties la igama, “Migana la u purun ga turuo, uavia kiban a me nakap meba tobutang ga tokiraraang.”
Iriro paga la tale ka betong, pa titot la mirulo. Are ratmat ga tubiat, na tara leba betang, iriro leba miigorala ga eba naganming gare ro, “Turuo iriro Karisito.”

Mirulo migat: Migana la alagiong migana o ubi la asagarung ga ula, ga aidangong maset, iriro migana la tolagiong ga maset toidangong. Pa migana o magabun la tolagiong, irire la alagiong Mamo irie la tosagaong ga muruo.”
Iudas la eba abung Iesu na kilalap ma karorap
Tie, Iesu la tiesong gare ro ga mitara giginam dalap a. Ga tiesong ga ugama, “Mirulo migat: Non kabirana mi leba toala maun inamaniap la nekaromela ga turuo.”
Tiesong gare tiro pa negimameng lop o usingnualap. Pa tale ameit, tiesong me aga.
Non kulot o usingnualap ang Iesu la ume na maset aime, la unama kagarat ai Iesu ga uabu bugam a ira aroma a.
Are ratmat ga oritigiong Simon Petro bugam a ga aulo, “Amariknang, tiesong me aga.”
Tie, iriro kulot o usingnualap la uabu bugam a ira aroma a Iesu la amarikong gare ro, “Ila Kakani, tiesnung me aga?”
Iesu la upulo ties gare ro, “Eba tarang nap o purun ga tabung na sup ga talang aun non migana. Irirot i migana la tiestung aime.” Tie uabu nap o parak na sup ga ualo aun Iudas Iskariot poi ang Simon.
Tara la uaro Iudas uriro purun uobur Satan na dalap a. Are ratmat ga aulo Iesu, “Paga la nuga akosarnang, tie akosarnang it Kakalait!”
Mirier lop ganam o usingnualap la maionama bo luaga la mepto uriro ties la uaramo Iesu aime Iudas, pa tale ameit muana o uriro ties.

Ume uale Iudas bo mirikbuom ma kakepup, are ratmat ga non kabirana ma la agatmeng namo ga aulor Iesu meba ala masauang pagap me uriro la ula babau o la ula aipieng, o meba ala alam pagap ba maun teip ga magaulap la karuk ma pagap ba maiam.
Iudas la uaror uriro nap o parak, tie talet kagart ga ula lavie. Ga betieng ara arubu.
Iesu la ualo maimai ula nou maun lop o usingnualap
Urie, iura ra Iudas me lavie, tie ugama Iesu, “Titot turuo Migana migat ang Morowa la tuaro bonim ula kakanu. Ga uaro Morowa bonim ula kakanu ira ruo Migana migat ang Morowa.
Pa tara la uaro Morowa bonim ula kakanu ira ruo, tie Morowa kan leba alang bonim ula kakanu toun, Migana migat ang Morowa, ga ebat akosarang Morowa iriro paga kakalait.
Lop tuam, tatak it tara la eba tonang ka ga mimi. Ga eba man toisinming. Pa marulo Iudaiap, aret tiro la mirulo: Tale kan puoming meba mila na pianam la tula una.
Pa titot la tualo maimai ula nou miun. La are ro: Mimi ut narit narit le naming migat me non teip. Narung migat me milam, aret tie le naming migat me non teip.
Leba mimi ba ut narit narit leba naming migat me non teip na gar tuang, tie irirot le masingala teip ga magaulap na uro kimanam gare ro, mimi lop tuam o usingnualap.”
Tiesong Iesu me Petro leba alang ibunam a ira a

Tie, Simon Petro la amarikong Iesu gare ro, “Ila Kakani, eba nala lagum?” Pa upulo Iesu, “Pianam leba tala una, titot tale kan puonung meba tonouluan ga nala una. Pa tubiat la eba tonouluan ga munang.”
Pa amarikong Petro, “Ila Kakani, Memani ga tale kan puorung meba noruluan titot? Eba talang ninimiap tung meba noagaralie.”

Iesu la upulo ties ang, “Nuga nagannung puonung leba nalang ninimiap nung meba toaganalie. Norulo migat: Tara leba ka tale kukurikang pura, eba tiesnang ma naien ma tarap gare ro, ‘Tale kan arit iriro migana.’”
